meta.description: FileMaker calculation function catalog. Prototype signatures are canonical from the source repository. Category, slug, doc_url and purpose are sourced from the Claris Help Centre index.
meta.update_instructions: Re-fetch source repo and compare against this file. Also re-fetch each category_page from help.claris.com to pick up new functions or updated slugs. For new functions, check the FileMaker Pro Release Notes at https://help.claris.com/en/pro-release-notes/content/ to determine the version introduced.
